offset.description: Character offset for file/resource content, or entry offset for directories. Use truncation.nextOffset to continue.

charLimit.description: Character cap for returned output. Effective output is also bounded by tokenLimit.

tokenLimit.description: Estimated token cap for returned output. Defaults to 4,000 tokens and cannot exceed 6,000 tokens.

charLimit.description: Character cap for serialized matches; runtime output is also hard-capped near 6,000 estimated tokens.

url.description: Exact http(s) URL to fetch. This tool does not crawl links, search the web, save files, or download binary bodies.

charLimit.description: Character cap for returned text. The backend also enforces a byte cap before decoding.

timeoutMs.description: Network timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 15 seconds.

path.description: Workspace-relative target path. For deliverables or generated files derived from files in a subfolder, use an explicit path in that same subfolder or nearest relevant existing folder; use the workspace root only when requested or truly project-level.

patchText.description: Patch text to apply. Prefer structured format: *** Begin Patch, then file sections like *** Update File: path with @@ hunks, *** Add File: path, or *** Delete File: path, ending with *** End Patch. In Update hunks, prefix unchanged lines with space, removed lines with -, and added lines with +. Add File content lines should start with +.

command.description: Command to execute. Before commands create files or directories, verify the intended parent directory and use an explicit relative path or cwd so outputs do not accidentally land in the workspace root.

cwd.description: Workspace-relative working directory. Use this for subfolder commands instead of prefixing the command with cd.
